Do you dream of a job with no routine work, where you build a unique finished product from A to Z? For a stable and valued family-owned company in the region, we are looking for a mature Structural Metal Worker / Fitter.

 

As a Structural Metal Worker, you are responsible for the full assembly and custom fitting directly onto the truck chassis:

• Reading Blueprint Plans & Preparation: You read complex technical drawings and bending diagrams like second nature. You saw, drill, cut, and work with lasers based on these plans.
• Assembly & Fitting: You assemble parts with precision down to the millimeter. Think of constructing stairs, doors, frames, and specific structures.
• Metalworking & Bending: You perform the necessary bending and drilling work. Logical reasoning is essential here: when a drawing is challenging, you know exactly how to make the parts fit together seamlessly.
• Light Welding: A small part of your duties includes MIG/MAG welding (assembling/tack welding). However, the main focus is on total assembly.

 Jouw profiel als Constructiemedewerker / Samensteller.

• Experience & Maturity: You have already gained solid and relevant experience in metal construction, assembly, or fitting (e.g., custom doors, stairs, or structures). Due to the complexity of the work, we are looking for a mature candidate who can work independently.
• Technical Insight: You excel at reading blueprint drawings, have excellent spatial awareness, and can reason logically.
• Metalworking Skills: You have experience with various metalworking techniques (drilling, bending, cutting). Experience with or training in MIG/MAG welding is a nice plus, but not a requirement!
• Language Skills: You communicate fluently in English.

You coordinate and supervise the food, team & workload from our central prep kitchen, which supplies to outlets in multiple sites around Brussel
 
 

• Work and manage bulk production, cooking, packing & finishing. 

• Handle orders from each outlet. 

• Place orders with multiple suppliers. 

• Manage stocks and inventory. 

• Plan daily, weekly & monthly workload. 

• Co-ordinate workload between day kitchen and evening shift. 

• Maintain a clean workspace and take care of kitchen tools. 

• Respect safety standards during the work. 

• Label and store all food according to HACCP standards. 

• Receive and check goods received. 

• Collaborate with the rest of the (culinary) team to ensure high-quality food and service for North Indian, South Indian and sweets 
 

• Min 5 year experience as a chef 

• Experience in Managing multiple outlets with Experience in similar positions. 

• Knowledge of Indian Cuisine is a must. 

• Good level of English/Hindi both spoken & written 

• Able to follow and execute under instruction & good in communication. 

• Team player & trouble-shooter 

• Knowledge of HACCP 

• Able to multitask and work efficiently under pressure.

As a Team Leader – Production, you play a key role in our manufacturing operations. You are responsible for coordinating the daily production activities while leading and supporting your team. By combining a people-oriented leadership style with a focus on quality, safety, and continuous improvement, you help achieve production targets and maintain the highest quality standards.

Your Responsibilities:

• Lead, coach, and motivate operators on the production line.
• Foster a positive, respectful, and collaborative team environment.
• Monitor and continuously improve quality, safety, and workplace organisation.
• Oversee the daily production schedule and ensure the production line operates efficiently.
• Manage stock levels and ensure the correct use of materials.
• Work with production software and ERP systems, including Iris and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
• Perform basic administrative tasks and prepare production reports.
• Communicate effectively in either Dutch or English with colleagues and stakeholders.

Are You the Team Leader We're Looking For?

• You have strong leadership and coaching skills and know how to inspire a team.
• You communicate confidently, clearly, and with a positive attitude.
• You are comfortable working with computer systems and quickly adapt to new software.
• You work accurately and have a strong focus on quality, safety, and efficiency.
• You are fluent in Dutch and/or English.
• Experience in a manufacturing or production environment is an advantage.

As a Van Driver & Logistics Operator, you are the link between our workshop and our customers. You will be responsible for carrying out daily logistics operations across Brussels and throughout Belgium, ensuring that every customer receives a scooter that meets our quality standards.

You will be one of the faces of MUTE on the road and will play a key role in delivering an exceptional customer experience.

Your Responsibilities

Deliveries & Collections

• Deliver electric scooters to customers.
• Collect scooters requiring maintenance or repairs.
• Carry out vehicle swaps when needed.
• Load and unload scooters safely and efficiently.
Logistics Operations

• Optimize routes to maximize operational efficiency.
• Keep the company van clean, organized and in good condition.
• Report any damage or operational issues concerning transported vehicles.
Customer Service

• Represent MUTE professionally during every customer interaction.
• Introduce customers to the basic operation of their scooter upon delivery.
• Answer basic customer questions.
• Ensure every delivery reflects the high service standards of MUTE.
Operational Support

When deliveries are completed, you will support the workshop and logistics team by:

• Moving scooters within the warehouse.
• Preparing vehicles for delivery.
• Cleaning and inspecting scooters.
• Charging and handling batteries safely.
• Assisting the operations team based on daily priorities. 
We are looking for someone who is reliable, proactive and enjoys working independently.

Requirements

• Valid Category B driving licence (mandatory).
• Comfortable driving a delivery van in urban environments.
• Reliable, punctual and well organized.
• Careful with equipment and company vehicles.
• Able to work independently while maintaining high quality standards.
• Physically fit, as the role involves loading and unloading electric scooters.
Preferred Qualifications

• Previous experience in logistics, deliveries or transportation.
• Interest in electric vehicles or sustainable mobility.
• Experience in the mobility, automotive or technical sector is a plus.
• Good knowledge of Brussels and surrounding areas.
Languages

• Good command of English and French.
• Dutch is an advantage but is not required. 
What We Offer

• 6-month full-time contract (38 hours per week), with the possibility of a permanent contract (CDI) based on performance and business needs.
• A dynamic and fast-growing company.
• A young, international and supportive team.
• A varied role with a high level of autonomy.
• Competitive salary based on experience, plus additional benefits.

 As part of our current growth, we are looking for an HR assistant for Europe Zone
 

Job Description
 
 

• Work with lead HR Europe, based in France (Paris), to manage all cross countries HR processes and provide operational & administrative support  
 

• Countries: France, UK, Belgium, Netherlands, Sweden 

• Consolidate the Performance Management cycle data at Europe level – Build & contribute to run all the related HR plans (annual assessment interviews, salary reviews, development plans, training plans)  

• Prepare all appropriate HR documents such as letter, employment contracts and ad hoc correspondences  

• Support the HR Personal administration tasks and lead some of the processes with external partners / providers (payroll coordination, follow up on fringe benefits, individual files,…) and maintain all the HR tracking database (Training plan, work permits, medical checkup, Health Insurance registration, Paid leaves….) 

• Support and run the onboarding process for new comers in the countries  

• Ensure the Processia HR academy regular follow up (eLearning platform) and propose appropriate communication to promote the content 

• Contribute to some HR transversal initiatives and team projects  

The Successful Applicant
 
 

• Job Skills  
 

• At least 3 years of relevant experience in HR in France, UK, Belgium or Netherlands. Ideally familiar with French social legislation 

• Small and fast-paced environment/companies first experience (“PME”) 

• Strong computer skills (Excel and Powerpoint as a must).  

• Fluent French and English, good knowledge of Dutch would be a plus   

·
 Behavioral skills: 
 

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, ability to build solid relationships with employees, positive open attitude, team spirit.
 

- Autonomy, willingness and ability to work remotely
 

- Flexibility to deal with last minute changes, can-do attitude, problem solver, ability to remain calm under pressure
